Examples.Title: Create a PDF
Examples.Description: This endpoint creates a PDF file with JSON data and your template. We support synchoronus and asynchronous PDF generation.
Examples.Code:
using var client = new APITemplateClient(apiKey);

var request = global::System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<object>(
    @"{
  ""invoice_number"": ""INV38379"",
  ""date"": ""2021-09-30"",
  ""currency"": ""USD"",
  ""total_amount"": 82542.56
}")!;

var response = await client.ApiIntegration.CreatePdfAsync(
    templateId: "00377b2b1e0ee394",
    request: request,
    exportType: "json",
    exportInBase64: "0",
    expiration: 5,
    outputHtml: "0",
    outputFormat: "pdf",
    filename: "invoice_89326.pdf",
    directDownload: "0",
    cloudStorage: 1,
    loadDataFrom: "https://mydata.com/get-json-data?invoice=j3hbski2uia",
    extractLink: 0,
    imageResampleRes: "150",
    resizeImages: 0,
    resizeMaxWidth: 1000,
    resizeMaxHeight: 1000,
    resizeFormat: "jpeg",
    meta: "inv-iwj343jospig",
    async: "0",
    webhookUrl: "https://yourwebserver.com",
    webhookMethod: "GET",
    webhookHeaders: "eyJ3b3JrZmxvdy1hcGkta2V5Ijoia2V5X0VLc3MxNWJKRXFBMkRHYzM4bkNXNzlaRER1ZUZJeiJ9"
);
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using APITemplate;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

  "urls": [
    "https://fileserver.com/a1.pdf",
